hero_tagline: Universal data converter — fast, local, nothing extra
settings_auto_preview_desc: Open file preview after conversion is complete
settings_archive_desc: Pack the converted file into an archive
settings_show_extensions_desc: Show extensions in the list (data.json instead of data)
settings_security_desc: All data is processed locally. No data is transmitted to the server.
settings_save_message: Settings are saved automatically on your device
format_desc_json: JavaScript Object Notation — lightweight data interchange format based on JavaScript syntax
format_desc_yaml: YAML Ain't Markup Language — human-readable data serialization format, popular in configs and DevOps
format_desc_csv: Comma-Separated Values — tabular format for storing and exchanging data between databases, Excel and analytics
format_desc_xml: Extensible Markup Language — universal markup language with tree structure, widely used in APIs, SOAP and configs
format_desc_toml: Tom's Obvious Minimal Language — minimalistic config format with clear structure, Rust community favorite
format_desc_ini: Simplest configuration file format with sections and key-value pairs, used everywhere
format_desc_md: Lightweight markup language for text formatting, converts to HTML, PDF and other formats
format_desc_html: HyperText Markup Language — standard web markup language, foundation of all web pages and templates
format_desc_txt: Plain text format without formatting — universal for notes, logs, code and simple data storage
format_desc_rtf: Rich Text Format — cross-platform document format preserving basic formatting, compatible with all word processors
format_desc_pdf: Portable Document Format — universal format for reliable document exchange and printing, preserves formatting exactly
format_desc_docx: Microsoft Word document — industry standard for word processing with advanced formatting and collaboration features
format_desc_odt: OpenDocument Text — open standard for text documents, used in LibreOffice, compatible with modern editors
format_desc_xlsx: Microsoft Excel spreadsheet — powerful tabular data format with formulas, charts and pivot tables
format_desc_jpg: Joint Photographic Experts Group — most popular raster image format for photos, uses lossy compression with small file size
format_desc_png: Portable Network Graphics — raster format with lossless compression, supports transparency, ideal for graphics and logos
format_desc_webp: Modern image format from Google — provides 25-35% better compression than JPEG with lossless and lossy options, supports animation and transparency
format_desc_avif: AV1 Image File Format — next-gen image format with superior compression, 50% smaller than JPEG, cutting-edge web standard
format_desc_mp3: MPEG-1 Audio Layer 3 — most popular lossy audio format, compatible with all devices, balanced quality and file size
format_desc_wav: Waveform Audio File Format — standard uncompressed audio format for professional recording, highest quality with large file sizes
format_desc_mp4: MPEG-4 Video — most common video container format, high compatibility with all devices and platforms, good compression
format_desc_mov: QuickTime Movie — Apple's video container format, widely used in professional video editing and multimedia production
format_desc_aac: Advanced Audio Coding — modern audio format with high quality at small size, used in video, streaming and mobile devices
format_desc_flac: Free Lossless Audio Codec — lossless audio compression, preserves original quality, ideal for archives and audiophiles
format_desc_ogg: Ogg Vorbis — open audio format with good quality/size balance, popular in games and open source software
format_desc_opus: Opus Audio Codec — modern audio codec with best balance of quality, bitrate and latency, standard for VoIP and web
format_desc_wma: Windows Media Audio — Microsoft format for Windows, provides good quality at low bitrate
format_desc_m4a: MPEG-4 Audio — audio container in MP4 format, uses AAC compression, popular in Apple ecosystem
format_desc_aiff: Audio Interchange File Format — uncompressed format from Apple, used in professional audio processing
format_desc_ac3: Dolby Digital — standard for multi-channel audio for cinema and DVD, provides high-quality surround sound
format_desc_avi: Audio Video Interleave — classic Microsoft video format, compatible with all players, but inferior in compression
format_desc_mkv: Matroska — universal open video format, supports multiple codecs, subtitles and chapters, choice of professionals
format_desc_webm: WebM — modern open video format for web, excellent compression, supports VP9 and AV1, HTML5 standard
format_desc_wmv: Windows Media Video — Microsoft format for Windows, good compression and quality in Windows ecosystem
format_desc_flv: Flash Video — format for streaming via Flash, used on YouTube, now giving way to MP4 and WebM
format_desc_3gp: 3GP — video format for mobile devices, small size, optimized for 3G networks and slow internet
format_desc_m4v: M4V — Apple video format, based on MP4, supports DRM, used in iTunes and Apple TV
format_desc_ts: MPEG Transport Stream — format for transmitting video over networks, used in digital TV and streaming
format_desc_vob: DVD Video Object — DVD disc format, contains video, audio and subtitles, standard for home DVDs
format_desc_mpeg: MPEG-1/2 Video — video compression standard, used in VCD and DVD, foundation of modern MPEG standards
format_desc_gif: Graphics Interchange Format — popular animation format, supports transparency, used for memes and graphics
format_desc_bmp: Bitmap — uncompressed raster graphics format, perfect quality but very large file sizes
format_desc_tiff: Tagged Image File Format — format for professional graphics and printing, supports layers and high color depth
format_desc_ico: Icon File Format — Windows icon format, can contain multiple sizes in one file
format_desc_qoi: Quite OK Image Format — modern lossless compression format, faster than PNG with smaller size
format_desc_tga: Truevision TGA — format for computer graphics and games, supports alpha channel and RLE compression
format_desc_exr: OpenEXR — HDR image format from Industrial Light & Magic, used in film industry
format_desc_hdr: Radiance HDR — format for high dynamic range images, used in 3D graphics
format_desc_dds: DirectDraw Surface — texture format for games, supports compression and MIP levels, used in DirectX
format_desc_pnm: Portable Anymap — family of formats for exchanging images between platforms (PBM, PGM, PPM)
format_desc_pcx: PC Paintbrush — old Microsoft format, used in DOS, supports RLE compression
format_desc_ff: Farbfeld — simple raster graphics format with high color depth, used in X Window systems
format_desc_mpg: MPEG-1/2 Video — video compression standard, used in VCD and DVD, foundation of modern MPEG standards
format_desc_voc: Creative Voice — classic audio format for Sound Blaster sound cards, used in DOS games and multimedia
format_desc_ape: Monkey's Audio — lossless audio compression format, popular among audiophiles for archiving CD-quality audio
format_desc_wv: WavPack — hybrid lossless/lossy audio compression format, supports both high quality and small file sizes
format_desc_mpc: Musepack — lossy audio format based on MPEG-1 Layer 2, offering better quality than MP3 at similar bitrates
format_desc_tta: True Audio — lossless audio compression format, known for fast encoding and decoding, used for audio archiving
format_desc_wve: EA Audio — audio format used in Electronic Arts games (FIFA, Need for Speed, The Sims)
format_desc_aud: Westwood AUD — audio format used in Westwood Studios games (Command & Conquer, Red Alert)
format_desc_apc: CRYO APC — audio format used in CRYO Interactive Entertainment games
format_desc_cin: Delphine CIN — audio format used in Delphine Software games
format_desc_roq: RoQ — video format from id Software, used in Quake III, DOOM 3 and Jedi Knight 2 games
format_desc_smk: Smacker — RAD Game Tools video format, used in over 2500 games including Diablo, StarCraft and Warcraft
format_desc_bik: Bink — RAD Game Tools video format, widely used in modern games for cutscenes and cinematics
format_desc_vqa: VQA — Westwood Studios video format, used in Command & Conquer, Red Alert and Blade Runner games
format_desc_vmd: Sierra VMD — video format used in Sierra On-Line games on CD-ROM
format_desc_mve: Interplay MVE — video format used in Interplay Productions games (Baldur's Gate, etc.)
format_desc_vid: Bethesda VID — video format used in Bethesda Softworks games
format_desc_str: PlayStation STR — video format used in PlayStation FMV sequences
format_desc_cpk: Sega FILM — video format used in Sega Saturn games
format_desc_mxf: MXF — Material eXchange Format, professional broadcast standard for television and cinema
format_desc_gxf: GXF — General eXchange Format, professional video format for broadcast servers
format_desc_prores: ProRes — Apple ProRes, professional video codec used in video editing and post-production
format_desc_dnxhd: DNxHD — Avid DNxHD, professional video codec used in video editing and broadcasting

about_desc_1: Formato is a powerful and easy-to-use data converter that works completely locally on your device. No server uploads, no file size limits.
about_desc_3: data formats, including JSON, YAML, XML, CSV, TOML, INI, Markdown and HTML.
about_fast_desc: Instant conversion thanks to native Rust data processing
about_secure_desc: All data is processed locally on your device. Nothing is sent to the internet
about_smart_desc: Intelligent data parsing and transformation with structure preservation
about_for_everyone_desc: Simple interface for developers, analysts and everyone working with data
about_tech_details_desc: View the complete project dependency tree — all NPM and Cargo packages used in Formato.
about_open_source_desc: Formato is an open source project. You can contribute, report issues or just browse the code on GitHub.
